5.2.title: Standard PPE Requirements
5.2.text:
Where a Verra Mobility Employee is undertaking work activities in environments where PPE
is required, the following minimum PPE requirements apply:

• Long sleeved shirts and long pants
• High visibility clothing
• Hard hats
• Safety glasses
• Sun protection (hat and sunscreen), and
• Protective footwear.

Additional PPE may be required depending on the nature of the work and identified risks.

4.1.2.title: Verra Mobility Employees
4.1.2.text:
Verra Mobility Employees are responsible for:

• Using PPE as required
• Taking reasonable care of PPE provided
• Inspecting PPE prior to use
• Reporting damaged, defective, or unsuitable PPE, and
• Ceasing work where required PPE is not available or fit for use.

5.1.title: Selection and Use of PPE Procedure
5.1.text:
PPE must only be relied upon where higher order controls are not reasonably practicable or
where PPE is required as supplementary control.

Decisions regarding PPE requirements must:

• Be based on hazard identification and risk assessment
• Consider the effectiveness of PPE in reducing the original risk, and
• Ensure that the use of PPE does not introduce new or greater risks (for example,
reduced dexterity or visibility).

PPE provided by Verra Mobility must:

• Be fit for purpose for the activity and environment
• Comply with relevant Australian or New Zealand Standards, and
• Be suitable for the individual user.

Employees must be consulted in accordance with Consultation and Communication
Management Procedure (IMS.05.01.PRO.01) where appropriate regarding PPE selection.

5.4.title: PPE Use and Care Procedure
5.4.text:
PPE must be:

• Worn as required
• Maintained in a clean and serviceable condition
• Stored to prevent damage or loss, and
• Withdrawn from use if damaged or no longer fit for purpose.

PPE will be replaced on a fair wear and tear basis.

4.2.1.title: Verra Mobility Employees
4.2.1.text:
Verra Mobility Employees are required to:

• Complete the Personal Protective Equipment Training Module (IMS.03.16.TRN.01)
annually, and
• Be provided with appropriate information and instructions, including:
o Correct selection and fit
o Limitations of PPE, and
o Care and maintenance requirements.

4.2.text:
4.2.1. Verra Mobility Employees

5.3.title: Client PPE Requirements
5.3.text:
Where Client PPE requirements apply, these must be followed unless doing so would result
in a lower level of protection. All PPE requirements shall be documented following
requirements outlined in Project Risk Management Procedure (IMS.03.04.PRO.01).

Where conflicts arise, the Leader must consult with the client or Client to agree on
appropriate PPE requirements.

4.1.title: Specific Roles and Responsibilities Related to this Procedure
4.1.text:
4.1.1. Leaders
All Leaders are responsible for:

• Determining minimum PPE requirements for activities under their control
• Ensuring PPE provided is fit for purpose and complies with applicable standards
• Consulting with employees regarding PPE selection where required
• Ensuring PPE requirements are communicated and understood, and
• Addressing non-compliance with PPE requirements.
